name: release-prepare
description: Compute release versions and notes, and optionally save a GitHub draft

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && ncc build src/index.js --out dist --target es2022 --no-cache --license licenses.txt && node scripts/collect-licenses.js
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist)"

author: hoverkraft
